design_rules: Keep the user-named Bawabat Al-Ilm target permanently even while its exact URL is unresolved.
Search saved voice engines before generic TTS discovery.
Treat every language as an independent voice lane, including dialect and locale variants.
Track voice gender/style/age/accent only when the provider actually documents it.
Separate TTS, speech-to-text, voice cloning and audio libraries; they are not interchangeable capabilities.
Prefer open/offline engines as fallback options where quality and language coverage are adequate.
Never infer permission to redistribute generated voices, voice models or cloned voices from API availability alone.

For Islamic/Arabic content, preserve pronunciation, diacritics, Quranic recitation and hadith-specific pronunciation as separate quality tracks rather than treating generic TTS as authoritative recitation.
